_comment: Empty on purpose. Volunteer sign-ups exist, but nobody has been contacted
yet, so none of that data belongs in this repository or on a published
page. When people have been spoken to and have agreed to be listed, add
them here, or point VOLUNTEER_APPLICATIONS_FILE at a file outside the repo.
contact_email, contact_phone and raw_response are private fields. They
reach Neo4j and stop there: the public export never reads them.
